title: Wallington Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospital contacts, Wandle flood zones, and local supply hubs for Wallington and Hackbridge (SM6).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AA. Travel guidance: from Wallington station, ~30 min walk north-west along Manor Road and Wrythe Lane, or take bus 151 or 157. Croydon University Hospital, 530 London Road, Thornton Heath CR7 7YE. Travel guidance: from Wallington station, ~15 min drive via Croydon Road/A232, or take bus 410 towards Crystal Palace. For major trauma, St George's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Blackshaw Road, Tooting SW17 0QT (accessible by rail to Tooting from Hackbridge). 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: St Helier Urgent Treatment Centre, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AA (co-located at St Helier Hospital). Croydon Urgent Treatment Centre, 530 London Road, CR7 7YE. 3. Area Hazards: River Wandle basin and wetland zones around Hackbridge, Beddington Park, and London Road corridor carry high river and surface water flood vulnerability in heavy downpours. 4. Essential Supplies: Supermarkets and high-street chemists along Woodcote Road, Wallington Square, and London Road in Hackbridge stock emergency drinking water, baby essentials, and first-aid supplies during outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
